about_short_description.short_description: MICSI offers an AI software to improve image quality with random matrix theory denoising.

product.name: MICSI-RMT
product.description: A software suite that enhances diffusion and functional MRI image quality by removing noise using the MP-PCA algorithm and supports quantitative analysis with weighted linear least squares and Bayesian fitting.

product.name: MP-PCA Denoising Algorithm
product.description: An algorithm that removes noise from MRI images by detecting noise components using random matrix theory, preserving anatomical structures without external training data.

product.name: Denoising for Brain MRI
product.description: Application of MP-PCA denoising to diffusion and functional MRI of the brain to improve image quality and enable high-resolution anatomical and functional mapping.

product.name: Denoising for Prostate MRI (Research Only)
product.description: A research-focused application of MP-PCA denoising to prostate diffusion MRI to improve efficiency and enable advanced diffusion metrics like fractional anisotropy.
